nativeFormats.html: cheerio-parsed original index links, headings and labeled fiscal table cells
nativeFormats.pdf: Targeted routing only; original PDF requires shared isolated preparation and text evidence, not invented HTML cells

fixtureBasis: Authored bounded native HTML fixtures; document URLs/years derive from the pinned catalog. These are not captured live source bytes and do not establish source-specific table schemas.

evidence.pathDialect: Zero-based selector result indices; /@attribute or /text(); closest(tr,li,p), preceding-heading and caption-or-preceding-heading are explicitly recorded Cheerio traversal operations. Header column locators refer to the first row containing th; cell locators to physical tr/td indices. Raw values are original decoded logical HTML field values, never synthesized prose.
evidence.schemaIdentity: Actual header strings hash-bound per native table; no merged/multi-level header inference

semantics.identity: Full native resource URL with meaningful FID, download ID, cHash and tenant/query parameters retained; scope includes source and publisher. Printed product/investment identifiers retained as strings; physical table row and per-amount column event IDs stay separate from canonical project identity.
semantics.version: Exact bytes hash and admitted sourceVersion; cursor pins snapshot hash and page-local offset. New server pages are returned as explicit HTML resource references and parsed with cursor=null.
semantics.geography: Registry source-to-AGS join is administrative reporting scope, not project location, enterprise seat, ownership or issuer verification.
semantics.dates: Fiscal year/period is distinct from publication date, approval/event date and retrieval date. Publication date accepted only from explicitly labeled valid calendar date; title and filename dates do not establish it.
semantics.finance: Only explicit labeled Ansatz/Plan, Genehmigt, Ausgezahlt, Ergebnis/Ist amount columns yield plan/approval/payment/actual, with explicit currency and single year. Missing/suppressed/ambiguous cells held. TEUR/T€/Tsd. EUR or €/Tausend EUR, Euro or € scale by 1000; MEUR/Mio. EUR or €/Millionen EUR or € scale by 1000000 to EUR. Unsupported, unrecognized or conflicting magnitude qualifiers are held rather than defaulted to scale 1; original header and numeric lexemes retained. Brutto/netto/unknown, issuer and budget scope attached as typed observations per amount event.
semantics.ownership: Explicit percentage table with named enterprise and fiscal year is an attributed ownership-share observation only; no legal identity merge, current-validity assertion or heat-network operation.
nonSubstitutions: Approval/publication notice is not an actual municipal account.
Planned/authorized appropriation is not actual spend/payment.
Schulverband and special funds never silently enter city totals.
Participation report does not prove a heat-network operator.
Interactive viewer link year is not current full-plan coverage.
Partial disappearance is not withdrawal; only explicit source withdrawal evidence is retained.
